articles.title: Stella Cherfas obituary
articles.summary: My friend Stella Cherfas, who has died aged 101, helped popularise yoga in Britain through her classes that spanned several decades. She was a well-known fixture in many of London’s community spaces, notably teaching free weekly classes at Covent Garden Community Centre’s Seven Dials Club.
